programmes.d: Jaden tries to deal the final blow to Yubel and save his friends using cards from Jesse's deck and the Supreme King.
In order to free his friends, Jaden must first figure out a way to destroy Yubel's nightmare of a final form that threatens to put all dreams of a rescue to rest.
When Jaden arrives late to his entrance exam for Duel Academy, he needs to go above and beyond expectations to prove that he deserves to make the cut.
The incoming class receives a welcome to Duel Academy, but Jaden finds a less-than-warm reception from freshman hotshot Chazz as he faces a duel challenge.
When Sho stumbles into the girls' dorm, he puts himself and Judai in danger of being expelled, forcing Judai to win a duel to win their freedom.
On test day at Duel Academia, Instructor Cronos steals a new card shipment so that he can stack the deck against Judai and embarrass him in front of the entire school.
Jaden must duel a mysterious duelist to free a captive Alexis.
Jaden continues his duel with the mysterious Shadow Duelist.

Crowler is frustrated that Jaden has won again and tells him and Syrus that they will have to fight a tag duel; Syrus loses and Jaden sees that he could have played a card called Power Bond, but the card is sealed by something in Syrus's past.
Jaden duels Syrus's older brother Zane in order to give Syrus's confidence a boost.

Chumley's dad has had enough of Chumley's low grades at school and goes to the academy to duel with him; if Chumley wins, he can stay with Jaden and Syrus, but if he loses, he has to drop out and go into the family business.

The day of the big Tag Team Duel has come, but Crowler has assigned Jaden and Syrus the best team out there, the Paradox Brothers; Syrus must help Jaden win, or they could both be expelled from the academy.
Syrus must overcome his issues with his brother in order win the match against the Paradox Brothers.
Dr. Crowler taps dueling whiz kid Bastion Misawa as his new protégé.
Jaden and the crew go looking for a missing Chaz, but instead find a dueling monkey that takes one of Alexis' friends hostage.
A group of students accidentally summons a duel monster into the real world, and Jaden has to defeat it to win the students' souls back.
Jaden finds himself in an outrageous duel against a sports fanatic bent on winning Alexis' heart and belittling him.
After a menacing Duel Giant appears on campus, Dr. Crowler convinces Jaden to track him down, and Jaden needs to defeat the titan in a duel or else become its next victim.
Jaden and the crew stake out the Card Shack to catch a thief, but when they find to culprit as former student who lives in the jungle, a wild duel ensues.
A copycat duelist steals Yugi Muto's deck and mannerisms, and Jaden must duel him and win it back.
Jaden continues his duel against the copycat duelist, trying his best to defeat the legendary and powerful deck that was used by the King of Games.
When a love-struck girl sneaks into the boys' dorms, Jaden challenges her to a duel to find out exactly why she's there and what she wants.
Jaden and Bastion duel to see who will represent Duel Academy in the School Duel.
Jaden and Bastion continue their duel to see who will win the honor of representing Duel Academy at the School Duel.
Not being able to stomach the thought of Jaden representing Duel Academy at the School Duel, Doctor Crowler arranges a duel that if Jaden loses, he'll end up in a lazy daze forever.
After getting shipwrecked, Chazz finds himself at the doors of North Academy facing a 50-man gauntlet.
Chazz's brothers order him to win the School Duel, or else.
With freedom on the line, Jaden and Chazz continue their duel out of school and personal pride.
When Jaden and the gang get trapped in an ancient world, Jaden must win a duel or be buried alive with the rest of his friends.
Jaden continues to battle in the duel of his life to save his friends and the chance to make it back to his world.
When the Shadow Riders descend upon Duel Academy to unleash the three Sacred Beast Cards, Jaden's up first to defend the school.
Jaden continues his duel against Nightshroud.
A vampiress named Camula is the second Shadow Rider to arrive at Duel Academy, but she's not there to suck blood, she's there to suck up souls.
Camula continues to wreak havoc at Duel Academy and sets her sights on Zane.
Jaden steps up to confront Camula with the souls of Dr. Crowler and Zane at stake.
Jaden and the gang get sucked into a strange vortex where a duelist who bears a striking resemblance to Kaiba forces Jaden to face his worst fears.
Chazz's brothers return to Duel Academy for revenge, forcing Chazz to face them in a duel with the deed to Duel Academy on the line.
The third Shadow Rider arrives and uses all her feminine wiles and charms to distract Bastion.
Jaden must duel Tania to snap Bastion out of a lovestruck stupor.
Bakura summons a winged dragon in preparation for a battle with evil Marik.
When Noah drives the blimp off its course and into a virtual world, Yugi and his friends are forced to duel the Big Five or be trapped in the cyber world forever.
Left on his own, Yugi must learn the new rules of dueling in the virtual world.
Seto and Mokuba must face their past when they visit the orphanage where they once lived.
Yugi learns the new rules to dueling as he battles Big One.
Tea is taken to a penguin continent where she is forced to duel the Nightmare Penguin.
Yugi is transported to the virtual ice field where Tea duels Big Two, in the form of the Nightmare Penguin.
Joey finds himself in a difficult courtroom duel against Big Three; Kaiba is tormented by the virtual recreations of his memories.
Big Three plays by his own rules, tricking Joey and causing him to fall behind in the duel.
Serenity, Duke and Tristan meet up with Big Four, who challenges all three of them to a duel.
